tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page background. Warm paper for the house; the kit's brown ink for the product.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Card and panel fill on ground. Cards are separated by tone and hairline, never by shadow.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headlines and body text on ground and card. The house's primary is ink itself: eyebrows, links, buttons. 15:1 both ways.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, the long sentence after a claim. 11:1 on paper.

tokens.name: label
tokens.usage: Mono eyebrows, sources, dates, footers. 6.5:1 on paper; never below 12px.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Hairlines and card borders. Borders, not shadows.

tokens.name: solomon-blue
tokens.usage: Solomon's color, and the one signal that a surface belongs to the product. On ink it is a FILL: the pill behind a highlighted word, the CTA, the slab, the doorway. On paper it also passes as text (9.6:1): Solomon's name and links on the house.

tokens.name: on-solomon-blue
tokens.usage: Text and pattern lines on a solomon-blue fill.

tokens.name: sun
tokens.usage: The house's warm accent: the highlighted word 'own', a fill behind ink text, a card's top edge. Never a software state; on the floor, yellow means CAUTION (ANSI Z535). Never as text on paper.

tokens.name: sky
tokens.usage: The house's second accent: the highlighted word 'verify', a fill behind ink text. Not Solomon's color. Never as text on paper (2.2:1 fails).

tokens.name: green
tokens.usage: Growth, and the ok state. A card's top edge on the house; the ok dot on the product.

tokens.name: spiral-red
tokens.usage: The mark's own color and nothing else. Never a state: on the floor, red means DANGER.

tokens.name: on-sun
tokens.usage: Text on a sun or sky fill.

tokens.name: state-ok
tokens.usage: The check passed. Word 'ok' plus a filled dot. Color is never the only signal.

tokens.name: state-warn
tokens.usage: Slow-but-correct, over budget. Word 'warn' plus a triangle, in ink. Never yellow, never orange.

tokens.name: state-refused
tokens.usage: The record did not settle it and Solomon said so. Word 'refused' plus a solomon-blue square with a 1px on-solomon-blue outline on ink. A feature, drawn like one.

tokens.name: state-unknown
tokens.usage: Could not check, or not measured. Word plus a dashed outline. Absence is rendered, never blank.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon gaps, dot to word.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between a label and its value.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Inside pills; between rows in a list.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on the product; grid gap.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding on the house.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between sections inside a page; the jali's pitch.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Section rhythm on a page; the pattern band's height.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page gutters at desktop; the deck's margin.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Tables, pattern bands, the record. Solomon's default.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Solomon cards and buttons; tile corners.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Squaloo cards.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Large house panels and the deck's cards.

tokens.name: radius-arch
tokens.usage: The doorway: top corners only, on a tall panel. The company opens onto the product.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Pills, the highlighted word, buttons on the house.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Rules and card borders.

tokens.name: stroke-mark
tokens.usage: The spiral's stroke at 100px; scales with the mark.

tokens.name: stroke-pattern
tokens.usage: Pattern linework at 1x. Lines, never fills: the pattern is light through a screen.

tokens.name: stroke-accent
tokens.usage: The colored top edge on a house card (the tile band on a wall).

tokens.name: shadow-none
tokens.usage: The system uses borders and tone, never shadows.
